title: Duration and impairment
about: The two context questions most patterns depend on. Until they are answered, scores are not adjusted for them and each suggestion carries a note saying so.

questions.text: About how long have these symptoms been present?
questions.why: Several patterns need symptoms to last a minimum time: about 2 weeks for a depressive episode, about a month for panic disorder or PTSD, and about 6 months for generalized worry, agoraphobia or a specific phobia. Until duration is recorded, scores are not adjusted for it.

questions.text: Do the symptoms cause marked distress, or get in the way of work, study, relationships or daily tasks?
questions.why: Most patterns need marked distress or a real effect on daily life; without it, the same experiences may be within ordinary range. Until it is recorded, scores are not adjusted for it.
